properties.name: title
properties.comment: The dialog's title; empty gives the host's own. Valid UTF-8 without NUL (std::invalid_argument).
prepare: require_dialog_text(incoming, "OpenFileDialog title must be valid UTF-8 without NUL");

properties.name: initial_directory
properties.comment: The directory the dialog starts in; empty lets the host choose. Valid UTF-8 without NUL (std::invalid_argument).
prepare: require_dialog_text(incoming, "OpenFileDialog initial directory must be valid UTF-8 without NUL");

properties.name: filter
properties.comment: The filter in Windows Forms' syntax, as set; filters() holds the host filters it parsed into. Anything but label|patterns pairs of *, *.* or *.extension throws std::invalid_argument.
hand: prepare_write keeps the filter grammar check; written parses the stored filter into filters_

properties.name: filter_index
properties.comment: The filter the dialog starts with, an index into filters() (Windows Forms' FilterIndex, which counts from one; this counts from zero). After the user accepts it is the filter they had selected, where the host tells; an index past the filters starts the dialog on the first.

properties.name: multiselect
properties.comment: Whether the user may choose more than one file (Windows Forms' Multiselect).

properties.name: file_name
properties.comment: The first chosen path, or empty. Before the dialog is shown, a name set here is the one the dialog suggests; writing it makes the chosen paths this one name (none for an empty name). Valid UTF-8 without NUL (std::invalid_argument).
hand: a view onto file_names_: the first chosen path, which show_dialog moves; write_view validates and makes the chosen paths this one name (none for an empty name)

not_properties.name: filters
not_properties.reason: the parsed form of filter; read-only

not_properties.name: status
not_properties.reason: the host's answer to the last show_dialog; read-only

not_properties.name: reset
not_properties.reason: restores every setting; a method writing each cell
